payload.label: ST1b host classes by cation d-shell filling (step 1; no model output read)
payload.rule: Oxidation states: first (most probable) guess of pymatgen Composition(reduced formula).oxi_state_guesses() with defaults; unassigned if no guess, O not exactly -2, any cation state non-integer, or any d-block cation with d count outside 0..10. Cation = element with positive state. d-block = Z 21-30, 39-48, 72-80; f-block = Z 57-71, 89-103; other cations main-group. d count = group - oxidation state. Class: any f-block cation -> mixed_f; else no d-block cation -> main_group; else all d-block cations d0 -> d0; all d10 -> d10; all d1-d9 -> partial_d; else -> mixed_f. Flag post_transition_d10_core (not a class): any main-group cation with Z >= 31 in groups 13-18.
